history.summary: The Shree Ram Mandir at Sethi Chowk is an old-city Ram temple in Panipat (Sethi Chowk Area, Panipat 132103, Haryana), described by visitors as a very old and peaceful Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Ram (Ram parivar). It has strong local devotion (4.7 rating across ~30 reviews) but no published historical documentation: founding date, builder and patronage are unknown. AMBIGUITY (verify): Panipat has several Ram temples (e.g. a separate Shree Ram Mandir at Israna, Panipat, and the Shri Ram Sharnam ashram in Model Town); the CSV row 'Shree Ram Mandir, Panipat' is ambiguous, and this file documents the Sethi Chowk temple as the most-reviewed city-centre referent. A separate listing for the same name at Israna shows hours 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM, which may or may not apply here.

town_description: Panipat is a historic city in Haryana, about 90 km north of Delhi on NH-44 (the Grand Trunk Road). It is famous as the site of the three Battles of Panipat (1526, 1556, 1761) and is often called the 'Gateway of North India'. Today it is a major industrial and handloom-textile (rug and blanket weaving) centre of the state.
